# Michigan Coin & Bullion
> Michigan Coin & Bullion is a coin and bullion buyer in Bloomfield Hills, MI that purchases gold bullion, silver coins, rare numismatic coins, jewelry, and estate collections from Metro Detroit families and collectors. They evaluate items in person, explain their offers transparently, and pay on the spot with no obligation to sell.

Michigan Coin & Bullion specializes in buying American Eagles, Buffalos, Maple Leafs, Krugerrands, gold bars, pre-1965 90% silver coins, war nickels, Morgan and Peace dollars, mint and proof sets, rare currency, and 10K-24K gold jewelry including dental gold and estate lots. They also stock bullion for buyers interested in purchasing. Every evaluation is done in person with a full explanation of how the offer was determined.

The business serves Metro Detroit, including Oakland County and Bloomfield Hills, and welcomes walk-ins during business hours at 10 W Square Lake Road, Suite 304 in Bloomfield Hills, MI. Their typical customers include estate heirs, downsizing retirees, longtime collectors liquidating holdings, and local bullion investors. The process is simple: call or text (248) 720-4092 with photos or visit in person, receive an honest evaluation, and get paid immediately if you decide to sell.
